record_type_quote: Given the academic impact and practical implications of Hsee and Rottenstreich (2004), we conducted a very close replication of their studies with two clear goals.

targets.title: Music, Pandas, and Muggers: On the Affective Psychology of Value.
targets.evidence_quote: We focused the current replication on Studies 2, 3, and 4 due to their similar hypotheses and experimental design, allowing us to combine them in a single data collection, presented to participants in random order. This section will explain the hypotheses (please see Table 1 for summary), experimental design and findings (please see Table 2 and Table 3 for summary) of each Study before providing an overview of the current replication based on these studies. Please refer to the section “Analysis of the Original Article” in the supplementary for a more comprehensive analysis of each study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Frozen registration is Stage 1. Its explicit warning says results were written using a randomized dummy dataset and will be updated after data collection. Those simulated results are not empirical replication outcomes.
